newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kondarl, Exxon sign 7.2-bln-yuan deal.
newsitem.headline: Kondarl, Exxon sign 7.2-bln-yuan deal.

text.p: A unit of Shenzhen Kondarl (Group) Co Ltd, has signed a 7.2 billion-yuan power plant deal in Shenzhen with foreign companies including Exxon Energy Ltd, officials said on Friday.
Shenzhen Qianwan Electric Power Development Co Ltd, a subsidiary of Kondarl, on Thursday agreed to take part in the 1,050 megawatt gas-fired plant, a Qianwan official said.

Exxon Energy Ltd, Kanematsu Power South China Co Ltd, Guangdong Electric Power Holding Co and China Energy Investment Co Ltd are also involved in the construction deal, she told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Exxon Energy and China Energy, a subsidiary of Hong Kong -based China Light & Power Co Ltd, will each hold 17.5 percent interest in the project, Exxon Corp said on Thursday.

Qianwan and state-owned Guangdong Electric Power Holding, which has a 51.79 percent interest in Guangdong Electric Power Development Co Ltd, will have a 36 percent stake in the project, the Qianwan official said.
"The decision on how to split the 36 percent between Qianwan and Guangdong Power Holding has yet to be made," a Kondarl spokeswoman said.
Kanematsu will take the remaining 29 percent, the Qianwan official said.
The plant, to be equipped with three 350 megawatt generators, is expected to begin operatation by the end of the century, he said.
Kondarl, a feed and poultry processor that is also engaged in the land transport business, acquired a 90 percent stake in Qianwan in 1996 for 80 million yuan.
"Project financing will be supported by the city government," the spokeswoman said but declined to elaborate.
"The three power generators will be bought through an international public tender," the Qianwan official said.
The plant will supply electricity to the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, he said.
